name: Gaian
description: Dry and rocky, with sand deserts. Extensively settled due to precious jewels below surface. Many were terraformed with water and plant life.
landingSpots: A sea of dunes expands beyond the horizon. A distant rattle can be heard.
Oasis hidden among a mesa valley. Its indigo-colored water is hallucinogenic.
A crack in a cliff reveals an underground city carved into the rock.
Abandoned nomad camp, now occupied by small alien creatures seeking shelter.
Carcass of a giant worm-like alien creature. Its shadow provides cover from the sun.
Mineral refinery and ironworks facility. Six large robotic drills remain active.

encounters.name: SINKING INTO QUICKSAND
encounters.text: ROLL GRACE - Success: jump to safety [+1]. Failure: lose 5 Health and 3 Energy.

encounters.name: THE WANDERER
encounters.text: A robed Android Synth gives directions to a Synth Arch Settlement, 4 tiles southwest.

encounters.name: WINGED NIGHTMARE
encounters.text: Cave shelter disturbed by 2 Dust Wasps. After defeating: Helix Wire + 60 Serum.

encounters.name: JEWEL LOOTERS
encounters.text: 2 Space Pirates. After defeating: 1 Contraband Package (ISF Settlement +1 Favor or sell at Corsair for 200 Serum).

encounters.name: LOST IN THE MIRAGE
encounters.text: ROLL MIND - Success: +2 MIN for 3 cycles. Failure: lose 6 Energy.

encounters.name: THE DESERT TEMPLE
encounters.text: Find a Neon Blade on the altar -> floor collapses -> fight a Glyphmoth Queen.

name: Calorian
description: Rocky and barren. Regular earthquakes, seismic activity, high temperatures. Surface often red/maroon from iron oxide dust.
landingSpots: Five concrete columns sustain an oil platform several hundred meters above the ground.
A field of hundreds of antennas, emitting an indecipherable cacophony of radio signals.
Canyon formed by a now-extinct river, layers of red, amber, and violet-colored soil.
Iron mine operated by automatons. Control room damaged, causing malfunctions.
The land bends, revealing a giant ravine that splits the terrain in two.
Remote-controlled rover vehicle. Unknown who still operates it and from where.

encounters.name: ALPHA 2 OBSERVATORY
encounters.text: A NetHacker from Medusa. DECRYPT THE CODE (3 MIN Challenge Rolls): Success reveals a Medusa Settlement 2 tiles south [+1 Favor]. Failure: lose 3 Energy.

encounters.name: GROUND FISSURE
encounters.text: ROLL VIGOR - Success: shove rock aside [+1]. Failure: lose 7 Health. -2 VIG and -2 GRA until Health restored to 100.

encounters.name: SPOILS OF WAR
encounters.text: Find a Gauss SMG and a Laser Accelerator mod.

encounters.name: ENDLESS SHIFT
encounters.text: EVO ROBOTICS factory, 3 Automaton Bots. ROLL TECH - Success: deactivate one, fight two, loot a Tesseract. Failure: lose 2 Energy, all three attack.

encounters.name: THE MARTIAN
encounters.text: Dead astronaut. A Laser Blaster with a Silencer mod lies next to him.

encounters.name: SKIRMISH AT METEOR KEEP
encounters.text: Aid the soldiers: fight 3 Rebel Fighters, gain 250 Serum [+2 Favor ISF][-1 Favor WARG]. Side with rebels: fight 2 ISF Soldiers, gain 2 Health Packs [+2 Favor WARG][-1 Favor ISF].

name: Vaporian
description: Hydrogen, Helium, and chemical elements form layers of gases. Landing on the surface is impossible due to colossal storms of toxic gas and vapor.
landingSpots: Rotating space station, used as a luxury holiday resort during the Old World.
Vapor refinery in low orbit. Processes gases extracted from the planet.
Modified asteroid used as a trade hub and refuelling station.
Small terraformed moon used as a clandestine club for hunting rare alien creatures.
Ring-shaped megastructure that encircles the planet. Used to be a space city-state.
Secret hideout of contraband cargo, hidden in the upper layer of atmosphere.

encounters.name: IN THE EYE OF THE STORM
encounters.text: ROLL GRACE - Success: escape [+1]. Failure: lose 4 Fuel and 6 Health.

encounters.name: ORBITAL RELAY
encounters.text: Hidden capsule 3 tiles northeast: DRONE_Spider + 300 Serum.

encounters.name: SERUM DISTILLERY
encounters.text: Confront the looters: attack 2 Vector Ace Fighters, loot 500 Serum from each. Avoid: lose 2 Fuel.

encounters.name: SEA OF VAPOR
encounters.text: ROLL TECH - Success: fix [+1]. Failure: lose 5 Hull. Only 1 Action Die per ship combat until Hull restored to 100.

encounters.name: THE ODD MERCHANT
encounters.text: Refuel at 20 Serum per point of Fuel.

encounters.name: DEAD OR ALIVE
encounters.text: Aid bounty hunter: fight the NetHacker, gain 150 Serum [+1 Favor Corsair][-1 Favor Medusa]. Help runaway: fight the Bounty Hunter, gain a random HACK [+1 Favor Medusa][-1 Favor Corsair].

name: Aquarian
description: High amount of water in their hydrosphere. Oceans cover most of the surface. Some have islands or archipelagos, others are completely submerged.
landingSpots: Small rocky isles covered in algae, surrounding a shipwrecked vessel.
Alien marine life research outpost in the diameter of an immense oceanic trench.
Floating city connected by water canals and moving platforms. Appears abandoned.
Transport elevator to an underwater secret facility. Water has flooded most of it.
Archipelago of virgin islands. Their plant life bears strange and colorful fruit.
Beautiful coral reef the size of a continent. Its jewel-like shapes shine during the night.

encounters.name: WAVE AFTER WAVE
encounters.text: ROLL VIGOR - Success: swim against current [+1]. Failure: lose 4 Health and 4 Energy.

encounters.name: NAUTILUS
encounters.text: Find 2 Energy Cells + Electroxyn Capsule.

encounters.name: FACILITY TEL 22
encounters.text: REPAIR POWER GENERATOR (3 TEC Challenge Rolls): Success: Orion II Armor + Tricillin Tablet. Failure: lose 5 Energy, attract 2 Voidcrawlers.

encounters.name: THE STRANDING
encounters.text: Xenobiologist reveals a Research Outpost 5 tiles northeast.

encounters.name: DEPTHS MONSTER
encounters.text: A gigantic Deepworm ready to attack.

encounters.name: UNDERWATER PRISON
encounters.text: Aid guards: fight 4 Guerrilla Commander + Rebel Fighter, gain random cybertech [+1 Favor ISF][-1 Favor WARG]. Join revolt: fight 3 Android Synths, gain 2 Testogate Hormones + transport inmates to WARG Settlement for 70 Serum [+1 Favor WARG][-1 Favor ISF].

name: Sylvanian
description: Biodiverse, high humidity, rich flora and fauna. Lush rainforests and jungles. High density of predatory alien life.
landingSpots: Grotto that serves as the lair of an alien beast. There's no sign of the creature. For now.
Atop a formation of interlocking branches and tree trunks, 100m above ground level.
Shrouded in mist from giant waterfalls rising over a quiet lagoon.
Among the vast fields of elephant grass of a savanna, surrounded by a meandering river.
Swamplands, next to a small empty hut inside a hollow mangrove tree.
Ancient stone temple covered in moss and vines, overlooking the tropical forest.

encounters.name: RAVAGED COLONY
encounters.text: Find an Electroxyn Capsule + Data Shard.

encounters.name: IN ENEMY TERRITORY
encounters.text: Taken to a secret WARG base. [+1 Favor WARG]: freed + Health/Energy to 100 + WARG Settlement location 2 tiles northeast. [0 Favor]: set free. [-1 Favor WARG]: pay 150 Serum or fight the Commander without weapons.

encounters.name: HOSTILE CHLOROPHYLL
encounters.text: ROLL VIGOR - Success: cut vine and run [+1]. Failure: lose 7 Health. -2 VIG and -2 GRA until Health restored to 100.

encounters.name: THE FOREST CHASE
encounters.text: Side with rebels: fight 2 Mercenaries, gain a ranged weapon mod [+1 Favor WARG][-1 Favor Corsair]. Help mercenaries: gain Combat Exoskeleton + 2 random grenades [+1 Favor Corsair][-1 Favor WARG].

encounters.name: TREETOP PARKOUR
encounters.text: ROLL GRACE - Success: +1 Hyperdrive charge and restore Energy. Failure: lose 8 Health and 3 Energy.

encounters.name: ALIEN GROTTO
encounters.text: A Xhiraptera Predator attacks. After defeating: restore Health and Energy to 100. Find 3 random status cures.

name: Ecumenopolis
description: Entire surface consumed by urban sprawl. All natural life destroyed in favor of megacity expansion. Now deserted ghost towns.
landingSpots: Legislative district of the city. The senate is partly destroyed and surrounded by tanks.
Legions of skyscrapers as far as the eye can see, now taken over by overgrown plantlife.
A labyrinth of narrow streets, illuminated by glitching holographic adverts.
Landfill waste processing megacomplex, over-saturated with mountains of junk.
Polygonal-shaped tower with 'Galactic Armada Sector V' painted on its walls.
Space elevator. Rust and lack of maintenance have rendered it inoperative.

encounters.name: CITY PARK
encounters.text: Find 2 Energy Cells + Data Shard next to a fallen security robot.

encounters.name: ISF TRADE PATROL
encounters.text: 2 ISF Soldiers + ISF Sentinel reveal an ISF Settlement 2 tiles southwest.

encounters.name: PRIMAL INSTINCT
encounters.text: Fight the Cyborg. At 10 Health or lower: ROLL TECH - Success: reset her systems, take to Synth Settlement (+1 Favor Synth Arch). Failure: she dies, extract a random cybertech implant.

encounters.name: MK-2 SX COMBAT MECH
encounters.text: An intact model of DRONE_OwO mech system behind a motorized arm.

encounters.name: TRAPPED IN THE SEWERS
encounters.text: ROLL GRACE - Success: flee and close gates [+1 Favor]. Failure: fight a Xhiroptera Predator.

encounters.name: DATA BREACH
encounters.text: Aid the hacker: fight the Android Titan, gain a random HACK [+1 Favor Medusa]. Side with the android: fight the NetHacker, gain random EVO Robotics cybertech [+1 Favor Synth Arch].
